en-US.longDescription: Wildix Integration Service (WIService) is a component that is required to be installed in order to use Popup App, URI dialing (sip-tel-wildix), Headset integration, screen sharing, Fax Printer, and Outlook integration. Also, starting from v.3.6.3 (on Windows) and v.3.7.2 (on macOS), WIService is accountable for automatic updates of Collaboration native app.
en-US.name: Wildix Integration Service

zh-CN.longDescription: Wildix 集成服务（WIService）是必须安装的组件，用于支持弹窗应用、URI 拨号（sip-tel-wildix）、耳机集成、屏幕共享、传真打印机以及 Outlook 集成功能。此外，从 v.3.6.3 版本（Windows 系统）和 v.3.7.2 版本（macOS 系统）开始，WIService 还负责 Collaboration 原生应用的自动更新。
